title: GateProcessDeclarationMetadata
description: App-manifest-declared gate-process DAG. Declares the step graph an elohim executes when a RelationalImpactEvent fires for a given content type. All step parameters are CID-addressed to existing ContentNodes, making the DAG inspectable by any elohim encountering it (per spec P3 'Inspect-Before-Execute').

name.description: Kebab-case gate name including version suffix (e.g., discernment-gate-v1-mechanical).

version.description: Semantic version of this gate process declaration.

eventType.description: Which RelationalImpactEvent variant this gate handles (kebab-case).

inputSchemaRef.description: CID or $ref to a JSON schema describing the gate's input GateContext shape.

outputSchemaRef.description: CID or $ref to a JSON schema describing the gate's output decision + side-effect shape.

supersedes.description: CID of a superseded gate-process-declaration, or null.

dag.description: The step graph this gate executes.

steps.description: Map of step-id to step definition. Keys are stable references used by edges.

terminals.description: Map of terminal-id to terminal node. Terminals emit a decision and optional side effects.

type.description: One of the seven v1 protocol-governed step types (spec §2.1).

params.description: Step-type-specific parameters. Shape depends on type. CID references may point to gate-rules-declaration, aggregation-spec, or escalation-target-spec ContentNodes.

next.description: Unconditional next step or terminal id.

edges.description: Conditional edges evaluated against GateContext. First matching edge wins.

when.description: Simple comparison expression over GateContext keys (e.g., 'ruleDecision == null'). Intentionally non-Turing-complete for static reachability analysis.

target.description: Target step id or terminal id.

decision.description: Decision shape emitted at this terminal (status + verdict/grounds as applicable).

sideEffects.description: Side effects the caller must execute. The gate does NOT execute them itself.

shape.description: For MintAttestation: attestation shape name (e.g., StoryPointLink).

paramsFromKeys.description: GateContext keys whose values populate the side effect's parameters.
